_comment: This directory is NOT a workspace, so it inherits nothing from the repo's tsconfig.
Without this file the build used TypeScript's defaults and reported two errors it then
deployed anyway: `node:http` had no types because @types/node was absent, and the import
of ./sources.ts was rejected because allowImportingTsExtensions is off by default.
Every workspace in this repo sets that flag, which makes `.ts` specifiers the house style
here — and the house style does not survive the trip out of the workspace.
moduleResolution nodenext is what makes `./sources.js` resolve to sources.ts.
